Due to the weight of this item, it will require assistance with unloading & moving at point of delivery.

Non-expansion bolt can be used close to the edge, where conventional anchors will damage the material. A through fixing for use in concrete, brick, beams, wood and pre-cast hollow concrete. Ideal for barriers, handrails, racking, curtain walling and balustrading.
b: For Securing Barriers, Balustrading, Handrails & Racking
